item.title: U.S. Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in third-country deportations
item.description: The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to resume deportations of migrants to countries that are not identified in their removal orders. It also plans to hear full arguments on the case.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Ezequiel Becerra)

item.title: Mahmoud Khalil on his detention by ICE: 'It is a stain on the U.S. consciousness'
item.description: Khalil was the face of the pro-Palestinian protests at Columbia University when immigration agents arrested him and sent him to detention in Louisiana. His new memoir is No Land to Stand On.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer now questions whether she killed her 3 children
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer is arguing that there wasn't enough evidence to prove she killed her three children. It's a striking turn after a lengthy trial that focused more on her mental state than on whether she took their lives.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: How Kenny Mason learned to follow his inner visions
item.description: Even among ATLiens, Kenny Mason is an outlier. As he faced a creative crisis — and commercial pressures — the rap-rock iconoclast realized that he feels most comfortable on the fringes.

item.title: This startup wants to prove gene-editing embryos is safe for making healthy babies
item.description: Origin Genomics aims to prove that the potential benefits of its technology for editing disease-causing genes in human embryos outweigh the risks.

item.title: How to hide your spending habits from retailers (so you don't get ripped off)
item.description: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

item.title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
item.description: Turkey's bid for regional influence comes as the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel and continue with the seven-month-old war on Iran.

item.title: OpenAI delays latest model over security concerns, as industry faces pressure
item.description: OpenAI's decision to hold back the model, called GPT-6.1 Astra, comes amid a broader push within the industry to slow the development of increasingly autonomous systems until safety measures catch up.
